name: LRT-1
details: Light Rail Line 1 (Green Line): Fernando Poe Jr. (Roosevelt) to Dr. Santos via Taft Avenue, including the Cavite Extension Phase 1 stations.

name: LRT-2
details: Light Rail Line 2 (Purple Line): Recto to Antipolo along Recto, Magsaysay, Aurora Blvd and Marcos Highway.

name: MRT-3
details: Metro Rail Transit Line 3 (Yellow Line) along EDSA: North Avenue to Taft Avenue.

name: EDSA Carousel
details: EDSA Busway (median lane), Monumento to PITX. Stop list may change -- check DOTr/i-ACT announcements.

name: Ayala-Washington Jeep
details: Board at the terminal near Telus/McKinley Exchange on Ayala Ave.

name: Megamall-Antipolo UV
details: Terminal is located at SM Megamall Building B Basement.

name: Cubao-Divisoria Jeep
details: Traverses Aurora Blvd all the way to Manila's shopping district.

name: Pasig-Mandaluyong UV
details: Connects Pasig to Ortigas via Shaw Boulevard.

name: BGC-Pasay Jeep
details: From BGC through Makati to Pasay via Taft Avenue.

name: Quezon City-Dasmariñas Jeep
details: Southbound route from QC to Dasmariñas Village.

name: Ortigas-BGC UV
details: Express UV from Ortigas to BGC via Makati Avenue.

name: Manila Zoo-Cubao Jeep
details: From Manila Zoo to Cubao via Santolan and Ortigas.

name: Taft-Ayala Jeep
details: Direct route from Taft to Ayala via Gil Puyat Avenue.

name: Malinta-Cubao Jeep
details: From Malinta through QC to Cubao.

name: Walk: Doroteo Jose - Recto
details: Covered walkway between LRT-1 Doroteo Jose and LRT-2 Recto.

name: Walk: EDSA - Taft Avenue
details: Walkway between LRT-1 EDSA and MRT-3 Taft Avenue (Pasay Rotonda).

name: Walk: Roosevelt - Fernando Poe Jr.
details: EDSA Carousel Roosevelt stop to LRT-1 Fernando Poe Jr. station.

name: Walk: Main Avenue - Araneta Center-Cubao
details: Carousel Main Avenue stop to the Cubao stations.

name: Walk: One Ayala - Ayala
details: One Ayala terminal connects to MRT-3 Ayala.

name: Walk: Gateway Cubao - Araneta Center-Cubao
details: Through Gateway Mall to the Cubao stations.

name: Walk: Ortigas - SM Megamall
details: MRT-3 Ortigas station beside SM Megamall.

name: Walk: Ortigas - Ortigas Center
details: Short walk into Ortigas Center.
